captaincook4d_task_graph.description: Task graph generation on CaptainCook4D (24 cooking procedures). Primary metric: F1 score on directed prerequisite edges.

precision.description: Edge-level precision on directed prerequisite edges.

recall.description: Edge-level recall on directed prerequisite edges.

f1.description: F1 score on directed prerequisite edges — primary benchmark metric.

worst_quartile_f1.description: Mean F1 on the weakest quartile of procedures, discouraging methods that improve the average by sacrificing hard scenarios.

edge_density_ratio.description: Ratio of predicted edge count to GT edge count — catches under/over-connection.

path_coverage.description: Fraction of GT directed paths covered by predicted graph — validates DAG structure.

topological_distance.description: Normalized topological ordering distance — rewards structurally similar graphs regardless of edge overlap.
